defects.problem: The opening left-hand F is F4 in treble clef, not a low bass note. The following turning figure moves mostly below and around it, not simply above it.
defects.evidence: https://www.pianostreet.com/images/dynamic-image-score.php?filename=rachmaninoffs/img-640/rachmaninoff_serenade_op3_no5_1892_version_Page_1.png — first system, both staves in treble clef.
defects.fix: Replace ‘a low F, small turning figures above it’ with ‘an F in the left hand, small turning figures around it’.

defects.problem: The cited opening windows include 0:55, whose onset rate is 2.6 per second, outside the stated 0.4–2.2 range.
defects.fix: Use 0.4–2.6 attacks per second, or end the cited quiet interval at 0:50.

defects.problem: 2:55 is not the record’s loudest five-second window. It is second overall and the loudest in the closing minute; 1:15 is louder.
defects.fix: Say ‘the closing minute’s loudest window comes at about 2:55’ instead of ‘the loudest window comes at about 2:55’.
